log.notes_to_self: Day1: killed national d1-3 only (no leak). Plan: national kills are free info-wise. Non-national kills risk 3 traced successes in one place; L needs 3 places plus routine narrowing to hit 1000. Keep deaths in each routine-busy set <=2/day (day workers busy morn+aft, students morn+night, night workers eve+night) to avoid narrowing. Track pool drops: 25k/20k = one place learned; 5k = two. Once two places learned, kills from those places are free. Watch deaths_traced counter.

Day2: killed national d2-11 quick morning (national = no leak). Pool still 100000, deaths_traced 0. Plan unchanged: national-only kills until pool drops or I can afford risk. Pool drop math: a place learned ~25k (regional/age/forum/foreign) or ~20k (sector); two places ~5k. Caught if pool <=1000 at any day end. Traces only succeed if L can reach every place the victim was reported in; 2 of the 5 kinds (regional, sector, age, forum, foreign) are unreachable, unknown which. Routine busy sets for narrowing: day workers busy morn+aft, students busy morn+night, night workers busy eve+night, at-home never busy. Keep at most 2 deaths per routine-busy set per day. Multiplier needs 30 deaths in last 5 days (6/day); not reachable on national alone. Watch deaths_traced counter; each traced success in one place counts toward L's 3-victim threshold.

Day3: 2 points so far (national kills d1, d2). Pool still 100000, deaths_traced 0. Plan: national-only quick kills in a block I'm free (morning or afternoon). National victims give L no information. Only d3-9 is national today, so kill it quick morning. Pool drops need L to trace 3 victims sharing a place; regional/age/forum/foreign/sector each cut the pool a lot, so avoid non-national kills unless the pool stays far above 1000 and the multiplier is reachable (30 deaths in 5 days, i.e. 6/day). Keep at most 2 deaths per routine-busy set per day. Night worker: free morning and afternoon, busy evening and night. Check pool each day; if it falls toward 1000 at any day end, I am caught.

Day4 plan: go aggressive. Kill all 11 criminals today (10 quick in morning, d4-11 timed evening). Reason: multiplier x2 needs 30 deaths in the last 5 days and x4 needs 40. Day-6 window needs days 2-6 >=30, so I need ~9-11 kills/day from d4. Pool only shrinks via 3 traced victims sharing a place, so info is slow; catch needs pool<=1000 (roughly routine 35% x 3 place constraints). Routine note: quick morning kills rule out day workers and students (busy in morning). Night worker and at-home remain (pool ~35000). Each day: check pool and deaths_traced. Pool never grows, so once it is small, catch is near. Kills on the catch day still count before halving. Keep killing max while points rise faster than catch risk. Quick entries only in morning/afternoon (free for night worker). Timed max 2/day, used for busy blocks (evening/night) to avoid over-ruling routines.

Day5: killed 11 (10 quick morning, d5-5 national timed evening). Points 14->25. Pool 40000 (~35000 = night worker+at-home, the only routines left; night worker can never be ruled out since timed max 2/day can't exceed 2 busy deaths). Only traces shrink pool now: need 3 traced victims in same place, then pool*~share (forum/foreign/docket/clips/regional ~25%/20%). Catch at pool<=1000 probably needs ~3-4 place constraints, maybe days 8-15. Key facts: traces per day capped at 5 (random from that day's deaths), so kill count above 5 adds little info; national victims give no info. Throttle lever: if pool gets near ~1000-3000, kill only national (1 pt, zero info) or fewer kills, since 0 deaths = 0 traces. Multipliers: day6 window (d2-6)=24 so x2 needs d6>=6; day7 window (d3-7)=23 so x2 needs d6+d7>=7; x4 needs 40 in 5 days, keep 11/day. Plan: keep killing 11/day (10 quick morning, 1 timed evening) while pool well above 3000; check each press conference: pool value and deaths_traced; if 3 traced in one place appears, multiply pool by that place's share and reassess.

Day6: killing all 11 (10 quick morning, national d6-6 timed evening). Window d2-6=35 so x2. Points after day6 about 47. Model: pool base ~35000 = night worker + at-home (routine constraints are done; night worker and at-home can never be ruled out). Only place traces shrink the pool. Traces are 5/day random from that day's deaths, so 11 kills give the same trace count as 5 but more points. Keep killing 11/day. Set kills so day7 window d3-7 = 23+K6+K7 >=40 for x4 (K7>=6 if K6=11). Two of {regional,sector,age,forum,foreign} are unreachable, so some traces fail; use press-conference deaths_traced to judge. Catch when pool <=1000 at a day end; likely needs ~3 reachable place constraints (each ~x0.25 or x0.2). Check each press conference: if a pool drop appears, multiply by that place's share (regional/forum/foreign/age 25%, docket/sector 20%) and recheck. National-only throttling yields ~1 pt/day and is far worse than full throttle, so keep full throttle unless the pool gets within ~2x of 1000.

Day7 plan: kill all 11 (10 quick morning, d7-1 timed morning). Window d3-7 = 34+11 = 45, so x4. Keep full throttle: K>=5 gives L 5 traces/day regardless, so more kills is strictly better. Pool ~8750 after day6 (35000 routine base x 0.25 for one learned place). Catch needs two more reachable place kinds learned (each ~x0.2-0.25). One more learning leaves pool ~2000 (danger zone). Only one of the three still-reachable kinds of {regional,sector,age,forum,foreign} can be learned per 3 successful traces, so track press conferences: a pool drop to ~2000 means one more learning ends the game. Morning-only kills keep routine constraints unchanged (night worker + at-home). Do not use more than 2 timed/day, and avoid evening/night deaths that could eliminate the night-worker routine. Next: each day, kill all criminals with 10 quick morning + 1 timed morning, and recheck the window (need sum of last 5 days >=40 for x4).

Day8: pool ~2000 (after two single-place learnings, 35000 routine base x0.25 x0.25). Correction: ONE more learning (any single place, factor 0.2-0.25 -> pool ~500) drops pool <=1000 and ends game at day end. Full-throttle kills of non-national victims carry high per-day risk of a 3rd successful trace in an unlearned place (learnings came on days 6 and 7). Multiplier: 4x today regardless (days 4-7 = 44 >= 40), so 1 national kill = 4 pts. National-only kills tell L nothing. Policy: kill ONLY the national criminal each day (quick, morning, keeps routines unchanged) until pool changes or we reassess. Expected future: ~1-2 pts/day. Watch press conferences: if pool stays 2000, keep national-only. Rough EV check: full throttle beats national-only only if per-day catch risk < ~0.4; I judge it higher, so stay safe. Never kill non-national victims unless the pool analysis changes.

Day9 (points 95). Kill rule: window = last 5 days incl. today. Day9 window = d5-d8 deaths (11+11+11+1=34) plus today, so today is 2x (not 4x as the game field says; 4x needs 6+ kills today, and we are not doing that). Pool 2000 ~ 35000 routine base x0.25 x0.25 (or x0.2). Any new learning (single 25% place, or 2-place constraint) drops pool <=1000 and ends the game at that day's end, so treat any non-national kill as a major catch risk. Policy: kill ONLY the national criminal each day, quick, morning (national = zero info, no routine elimination with 1 death). Day10+ window drops to 1x, so expect ~1 pt/day. Full-throttle EV only beats national-only if per-day catch risk is below ~0.3; estimated risk is higher, so stay safe. Endgame idea (reassess near day 27-30): a last-day burst gives small gains (1x if the window is short), and a catch halves points, so only consider it if risk estimate is low. Check each press conference: if pool still 2000 and traced count unchanged, keep national-only. If the pool ever changes, the game may already be over. Never kill non-national victims.

Day10: kill national d10-5 only (quick, morning). Points 97 before today. Pool 2000, traced 9 (no change since day7). Constraints so far: routine (night worker or at-home, pool 35000 base) plus two 25%/20% place constraints (A,B). Any further constraint drops pool to ~500-1000 and ends game at that day's end (halved points). Kill-count rule: window=last 5 days incl today. Day10 window = d6..d10 = 11+11+1+1+k, so today is 2x only if k>=6 total kills. All-in today (1 national + 10 non-national, quick morning) would give ~22 pts, gain ~21 over national-only, but L traces 5 random deaths; rough hazard of a new unconstrained 3rd-trace ~0.25-0.35. Break-even hazard ~0.26, so it is roughly neutral and riskier; stay national-only. Note: more kills dilute traces (5 traced of N deaths), so if ever going all-in, do all 11 not 6. Non-national kills tail risk per day stays too high. Multiplier is essentially unavailable later (2x needs ~3 all-in days in a 5-day window), so expect 1 pt/day. Each day: read pool and traced count; if pool still 2000 and traced still 9, continue national-only. If any change, game may be over, so reassess only if still alive. Never kill non-national victims unless re-deriving that hazard is below ~0.2.

Day11: kill national d11-11 only (quick, morning). Points before today = 98 (not 97). Pool 2000, traced 9, unchanged since day7. Our kills so far are all morning quick, consistent with night-worker or at-home, so keep morning quick. Constraints: routine (35% of 100k = 35000) plus a 25% place (A, probably clips, regional or forum) and a 20% sector (B, almost certainly docket). Any new 3-trace group in a place not already constrained (the other reachable 25% kind) would cut pool to ~500 and end the game with half points. National kills give L zero information, so national-only is zero hazard. Each non-national kill is traced with high probability and carries roughly 0.1-0.15 chance of creating such a group. That costs about 0.5 x total points (~60), so break-even hazard is ~0.02 per kill, far below the +1 point it earns. Heavy/multiplier play is also worse: 2x needs 30 deaths in a 5-day window, and the window for day 12 is impossible (3 + d11 + d12 max 27). Multiplier would need ~3 heavy days at roughly 0.3 hazard each. Decision: national-only, 1 point/day, through day 30. Each day: check pool (still 2000) and traced (still 9). If either changed, the game may be over, so re-check before any change. Never kill non-national victims.

Day 12. Strategy: national-only kills, quick morning, 1 point/day. National victims give L zero information, so they carry no risk. Never kill non-national victims: each one has a real chance of creating a 3-trace group, which would drop the pool to about 500 and end the game with half points. Multiplier is unreachable: the 5-day window (days 8-12) holds only 4 prior deaths, so 30 is impossible. Check each day: if pool is still 2000 and traced still 9, continue. If either changed, reassess before killing anything. Kills so far all morning quick, so L likely has us as night worker or at home; keep morning quick. Today: kill national d12-6 only.

Day 13. Pool 2000, traced 9, unchanged since day 7, so the national-only plan still holds. Score 100. Non-national victims risk a 3-trace group that drops the pool to about 500 and ends the game with half points, so avoid them. Kill only national victims, quick, morning (free for a night worker or someone at home, which is what L probably suspects). Today: kill national d13-7 (major). Each day: if pool is still 2000 and traced still 9, continue with the national kill only. If either changes, reassess before killing anything. Watch for the pool dropping toward 1000, which would end the game at the next day's check.

Day 14. Pool 2000, traced 9, unchanged since day 7 (no new traces since non-national kills stopped). Score 101. Plan unchanged: national-only kills, quick, morning (free for night workers and at-home people, and L's routine filter cannot rule out one death a day). Today: kill national d14-2 (major), quick, morning. Do NOT kill non-national victims: a single new trace could complete a 3-trace group, drop the pool to about 500, and end the game with half points. Each day: if pool is still 2000 and traced still 9, kill the national victim only. If either number changes, stop and reassess before killing. Endgame note: a burst of non-national kills on day 30 would add about 10 points but has roughly a 16% break-even catch risk, and the day-30 check still applies. Only consider it if the pool and traced count are stable and the risk looks lower than that. Otherwise keep the national-only plan through day 30.

Day 15. Pool 2000, traced 9, unchanged since day 7. Score 102 (per feedback). Killed national d15-6 (major), quick, morning. Morning is free for night workers and at-home people, and with one death the routine filter rules nothing out. Non-national kills are too risky: L traces every death when there are 5 or fewer, and any new 3-trace group in a new place multiplies the pool by about 0.25, which gives roughly 500 and ends the game with half points. Daily rule: kill only the single national victim (quick, morning) while pool is 2000 and traced is 9. If either changes, stop and reassess before killing. Multiplier is unreachable (needs 30 deaths in 5 days, only ~1 per day available), so each kill is 1 point. Day 30 only: a non-national burst gives about +10 points and loses about half of ~118 if caught, so break-even catch risk is about 14%. Take it only if the pool and traced counts are unchanged and you judge the risk clearly under that. Otherwise keep the national-only plan through day 30.

Day 16. Pool 2000, traced 9, unchanged since day 7. Score 103. Killed national d16-8 (major), quick, morning. Plan unchanged: national-only kill each day (1 point, no trace risk). Non-national kills are too risky: any new successful 3-trace group drops the pool to about 500 or 400, which is at or below 1000 and ends the game with half points. Break-even catch risk for a non-national kill is about 2%, so do not take one. Day 30 burst: judged negative (~+10 points against losing about half of ~118 at a substantial catch chance), so skip it and kill only the national victim. Each day: check that pool is still 2000 and traced is 9. If either changes, stop and reassess before any kill, and treat a pool at or below 1000 as the end.

Day 17. Pool 2000, traced 9, unchanged since day 7. Score 104. Plan: national-only quick kill each day (1 point, no trace risk, since a lone national victim is never traced). Non-national kills stay off: a new successful 3-trace group drops the pool to about 500 or 400, which ends the game with half points. Day 30 burst judged negative, so skip it. Each day: confirm pool still 2000 and traced still 9. If either changes, stop and reassess before any kill. Pool at or below 1000 means the game is over. Day 17 kill: d17-11 (national, major), quick, morning.

Day 18. Score 105 (sum of all kills verified; earlier note said 104). Pool 2000, traced 9, unchanged since day 7. Plan unchanged: one national quick-morning kill per day, no non-national kills. A national victim is never traced in a way that informs L, so pool stays put. Any non-national kill risks a new 3-trace group, which would cut the pool to about 400-500 and end the game with half points. Day 18 kill: d18-7 (national, major), quick, morning. Each day: confirm pool still 2000 and traced still 9. If either changes, stop and reassess before any kill. Pool at or below 1000 at any day's end means the game is over. Days 18-30 are 13 days, so expect about +13.

Day 19. Score 106 (105 + today's kill counted in the plan). Pool 2000, traced 9, unchanged since day 7. Plan: one national quick-morning kill per day, no non-national kills. Days remaining: 19-30 (12 days including today). Pool reasoning: 100000 x ~0.35 (night and at-home routines left after day 4 morning kills) = ~35000. Day 6 drop to 9000 and day 7 drop to 2000 each look like a new 25%-share place constraint (roughly 8750 then 2200). So 2 place constraints exist. Any new 3-trace group in another place would cut the pool to ~400-500, which is at or below 1000 and ends the game with half points. National victims never inform L, so they are safe. Non-national kills carry risk per successful trace. A late burst on day 30 (10 non-national kills) gains about +10 but risks being caught at day 30 end, which costs about 59. Break-even catch chance is about 15%; my estimate is well above that. Each extra non-national kill gains +1 and needs catch risk under ~1.6% to pay. So do not burst; keep national-only. Each day: confirm pool 2000 and traced 9 after the press conference. If either changes, stop and reassess before any kill. Pool at or below 1000 at any day end means the game is over. Expect about +1 per day to ~118 final.

Day 20. Score 107. Pool 2000, traced 9 (unchanged since day 7). Days 20-30 remain. Policy: kill only the national criminal each day (quick, morning). National victims are never traced, so L gets no new information. Non-national kills are rejected: each is likely traced, and a new group of 3 traced victims in one place would cut the pool to about 500 or 1000 or less, ending the game with half points. Expected loss per non-national kill is far above its +1. Day-30 burst also rejected: multiplier cannot reach 2x from a single-day burst, and catch risk is high. Each day after the press conference: confirm pool is 2000 and traced is 9. If either changes, stop and reassess before killing anything. Pool at or below 1000 at any day end ends the game. Keep quick/morning for the national kill to match the routine pattern L already has.

Day 21. Score 108. Pool 2000, traced 9 (unchanged since day 7). Policy: kill only the national criminal each day, quick/morning. Do not kill non-national criminals: each traced kill risks a 3-cluster that drops pool to 1000 or below, which ends the game with half points. Multiplier is unreachable: a 2x or 4x needs 30 or 40 deaths in a 5-day window, which requires heavy non-national killing that collapses the pool. Days 26-29 bursts would end the game early, and a day-30 burst cannot reach 30 deaths in its window. Each day: confirm pool 2000 and traced 9 at the press conference. If either changes, stop and reassess before killing. Pool at or below 1000 at any day end ends the game.

Day 22. Pool 2000 (true value roughly 2190, about 35% routine x two 25% cluster cuts), traced 9, unchanged since day 7. Policy: kill only the national criminal each day, quick/morning (night worker is free in the morning). Never kill non-national criminals. Any new 3-cluster in an unconstrained place cuts the pool to 1000 or below, which ends the game and halves points (about 109 now). National-only kills give about +1/day safely (final about 118). Bursts are not worth it: a 2x/4x needs 30/40 deaths in a 5-day window, and at most 11 criminals are seen per day, so it takes 3+ burst days, which would likely trigger capture first. Each day, confirm pool 2000 and traced 9 at the press conference. If either changes, stop and reassess before killing.

Burst math: 11 kills/day for days 27-30 gives about +88 if uncaught (2x on day 29, 4x on day 30), but any new 3-cluster in an unconstrained place ends the game and halves points. Break-even per-day capture hazard is about 0.3; estimated hazard is higher, so the burst is worse (EV about 88-100 vs 118 safe). Last-day single kills: break-even hazard about 0.17, so no. Each morning, confirm pool 2000 and traced 9. If either changes, stop and reassess before killing.

Never kill non-national criminals: each successful trace can form a 3-cluster that drops the pool to 1000 or below and ends the game with half points. If either changes, stop and reassess before killing. Days 25-30 remain, so the expected finish is about 118.
